examples.name: Default
examples.summary: One gap between two stub sections. The gap renders `flush`, so the rule it shares with the section above is drawn once — every junction on the page stays a single hairline. Switch `size` to see the three steps.

examples.name: Hatch
examples.summary: The diagonal hatch drawn in the gap itself. This is the texture’s home on a framed page: the gap holds no copy, so the hatch gives the break its own identity without sitting behind a headline.

examples.name: Sizes
examples.summary: Every `size` value in one stack, each gap labelled by the band above it: `small` keeps two related bands close, `medium` is the ordinary break between sections, `large` opens a new part of the page. The 1 : 2 : 3 ratio is what keeps the three weights unmistakable at every viewport width.
